welcomeCopy: A closer look at Bruma. Explore the collection, care for each order, and see a coffee store come together.
shared: A shared portfolio demo. Changes are visible to everyone; purchases are simulated.
loadingCopy: The demo service may take a moment to wake up. Your next ritual is on its way.
connectionCopy: Please try again in a moment. Your selection stays with you.
renewed: Demo access renewed. You can retry your changes.
stockLimit: Your bag has reached the available stock for this variant.
editCopy: Prices are shared by whole bean and ground coffee of the same weight. Changes are visible to all visitors.

errors.validation: Check the entered values and try again.
errors.edit_conflict: Another visitor changed this coffee. Your entries are kept; close and reopen the editor to review the latest values.
errors.store_reset: The shared demo was reset. Review the latest selection before trying again.
errors.session_expired: Your demo access expired. Enter again below, then retry your changes.
errors.server_error: The changes could not be saved. Your entries are kept; please try again.
